typeName.description: Type to submit the action for.

actionName.description: Actual name of action that will be executed. For internal usage only.

args.description:
Parameters to be passed to {@link action}.
For member methods, include `this` as a key with the value being an instance of {@link typeName}.
To avoid losing fields on unsaved types, use the `@db(persistAllFields=true)` annotation.

nodePool.description: Id for {@link App.NodePool} to run action on.

runOnlyOnce.description:
If set true, then only one instance of the {@link AsyncAction} produced by {@link AsyncAction#submit}ting this spec
can exist at a time. If there is already an instance of the action persisted, calling {@link AsyncAction#submit}
with the same action will result in an error and the existing action must be removed before being submitted
again. To use this field simply to prevent concurrent runs but NOT persist the results of an execution,
set `cleanupOnSuccess` true.

The id of the AsyncAction will be used to determine whether actions are the same (and therefore should be prevented
from running multiple times):
 1. If `actionId` is set on the spec, then that id will be used.
 2. Otherwise, the id of the AsyncAction will be determined by hashing the spec's `typeName`, `action`, `args`, and
    `hardwareProfile`.

actionId.description:
If set, this will be the id of the persisted AsyncAction.
NOTE: Setting this field means that submitting another action with the same id will overwrite any previous run.

cleanupOnSuccess.description: If set to `true`, then the AsyncAction will be removed if it completes without any errors.

timeoutMinutes.description:
If specified, the number of minutes that will elapse, since the action was submitted, before it is interrupted.  If
the action times out, the error will indicate so.  Note that this cannot be specified at the same time as
{@link skipQueues}.  An error will be thrown if an attempt is made to do so.

Note that when an action times out, there is only a request made to interrupt the actual running action if it is
possible to do so.  Even if possible, it may not happen immediately and that action may continue to run after the
timeout is processed (i.e. there is no waiting for the action to be interrupted).

skipQueues.description:
Execute the {@link Action} in the background, but bypass {@link ActionQueue}.
If set to `true`, provides potentially lower latency in exchange for exposure to risk of {@link Server} death or restart.

Note: If no nodePool is specified, the {@link Action} will run in the local JVM of the node that submitted the action, which will consume resources.

title: Spec for submitting action into {@link AsyncAction}.
name: AsyncActionSpec
